items.text: On April 16, Fibber McGee and Molly made its debut on NBC Radio.
items.question: Who in your house listened to Fibber McGee and Molly, and where did the radio sit?
items.source_quote: April 16 – Fibber McGee and Molly debuts on NBC Radio.

items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 3 cents an ounce.
items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost three cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: Fred Astaire introduced Cheek to Cheek in the film Top Hat, and his record of it was listed among the top popular records of 1935 in the United States.
items.question: Did you see Top Hat at the pictures or hear Fred Astaire's record of Cheek to Cheek, and who were you with?
source_quote: "Cheek to Cheek" w.m. Irving Berlin. Introduced by Fred Astaire in the film Top Hat
The top popular records of 1935 listed below
Fred Astaire "Cheek to Cheek" Brunswick 7486 June 26, 1935 (1935-06-26) August 1935 (1935-08) US Billboard 1935 #1, US #1 for 11 weeks

items.text: On May 24, the first nighttime Major League Baseball game was played, between the Cincinnati Reds and the Philadelphia Phillies at Crosley Field in Cincinnati.
items.question: Do you remember the first ball game you saw or heard played at night under the lights, and who took you?
items.source_quote: May 24 – The first nighttime Major League Baseball game is played, between the Cincinnati Reds and Philadelphia Phillies at Crosley Field in Cincinnati.

items.text: On January 11, Amelia Earhart became the first person to fly solo from Hawaii to California.
items.question: Who first told you about Amelia Earhart, and where were you living when her flights were in the news?
items.source_quote: January 11 – Amelia Earhart becomes the first person to fly solo from Hawaii to California.
